questions.prompt: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
questions.fact: The famous line was broadcast with a missing article, and he maintained for years that he had said it.

questions.prompt: Which force resists motion between two surfaces in contact?
questions.fact: Getting something moving takes more force than keeping it moving, because the static form is stronger than the kinetic.

questions.prompt: Which Olympic sport features a balance beam?
questions.fact: The beam is ten centimetres wide, and routines must include a full-length movement along it.

questions.prompt: Which band released the song 'Stairway to Heaven'?
questions.fact: It was never released as a single in its home market, yet became one of the most requested radio tracks ever.

questions.prompt: Which continent is the driest on average?
questions.fact: Parts of it have seen no rain for roughly two million years, making them drier than any hot desert.

questions.prompt: Which author wrote the 'Sherlock Holmes' story 'The Hound of the Baskervilles'?
questions.fact: He had killed the detective off years earlier and brought him back partly under pressure from readers and publishers.

questions.prompt: Which key is typically used to interrupt a running command in a terminal?
questions.fact: It dates to teletype terminals, where the combination sent a signal asking the operating system to end the foreground process.
